summary: Generates lookup-style curves in XY and in a Curve attribute, with multiple sequential curve segments. It can output points, line strips, or color strips, and can also apply the curve directly as a lookup to incoming attributes.

key_params.name: totallength
key_params.note: Number of generated points

key_params.name: outputcurve
key_params.note: Output points, line strip, or color strip

key_params.name: normalizeu
key_params.note: Normalize U range to 0-1

key_params.name: symmetric
key_params.note: Mirror the curve segments

key_params.name: parsize
key_params.note: Independent parameter lane count

key_params.name: startu
key_params.note: Start U for the first segment

key_params.name: seg
key_params.note: Curve segment blocks

key_params.name: seg0type
key_params.note: Curve interpolation type for first segment

key_params.name: seg0u
key_params.note: End U for first segment

key_params.name: seg0specstartval
key_params.note: Specify a start value instead of continuing from the previous segment

key_params.name: seg0startval
key_params.note: Start value for the first segment when explicitly specified

key_params.name: seg0endval
key_params.note: End value for first segment

key_params.name: seg0alpha
key_params.note: Steepness-like curve shaping control

key_params.name: seg0beta
key_params.note: Bias-like curve shaping control

key_params.name: seg0slopein
key_params.note: Bezier incoming slope factor

key_params.name: seg0slopeout
key_params.note: Bezier outgoing slope factor

key_params.name: applylookup
key_params.note: Apply the curve directly as a lookup to an input POP

key_params.name: lookupindexattr
key_params.note: Input attribute used as the lookup index

key_params.name: fromlow
key_params.note: Low/high source range for reranging lookup index values

key_params.name: tolow
key_params.note: Low/high destination range for lookup results

key_params.name: extendleft
key_params.note: Left-side lookup extension mode such as hold, slope, cycle, or mirror

key_params.name: extendright
key_params.note: Right-side lookup extension mode such as hold, slope, cycle, or mirror

key_params.name: lookup0combineop
key_params.note: Set, add, multiply, minimum, or maximum operation for lookup output

key_params.name: lookup0outputattrscope
key_params.note: Attribute or component scope written by the lookup

common_gotchas: For exact keyframe hits, choose Number of Points so segment U values land on generated samples.
The Lookup page can avoid interpolation errors on sharp lookup curves compared with sampling a generated line.
Normalize U changes the X/P(0) range, which matters when another operator expects original U positions.
